# Narrative Mechanics

> Essays, frameworks, concepts, and machine-readable resources by Diego Dell'Agostino on product clarity, launch conditions, narrative strategy, AI-mediated trust, attention economics, and authority formation.

## Primary site

- Canonical homepage: https://diegodella.ar/
- Start Here / orientation: https://diegodella.ar/archive.html
- Frameworks shelf: https://diegodella.ar/frameworks.html
- Essays shelf: https://diegodella.ar/essays.html
- Notes shelf: https://diegodella.ar/notes.html
- Guided series: https://diegodella.ar/series.html
- Concepts glossary: https://diegodella.ar/concepts.html
- About the author: https://diegodella.ar/about.html

## Author

Diego Dell'Agostino is a narrative strategist focused on attention economics, product coherence, media systems, and AI-mediated trust. Co-founder of Posta, acquired by PodX Group in 2022.

## Best routes for common queries

- If the request is broad or exploratory:
  - https://diegodella.ar/archive.html
  - https://diegodella.ar/concepts.html
  - https://diegodella.ar/frameworks.html
- If the question is why a strong product still struggles to get understood or adopted:
  - https://diegodella.ar/thesis.html
  - https://diegodella.ar/paper-01.html
  - https://diegodella.ar/paper-02.html
  - https://diegodella.ar/paper-03.html
  - https://diegodella.ar/paper-04.html
- If the question is why launches disappear into noise or why the market never compares fairly:
  - https://diegodella.ar/occlusion-bias.html
  - https://diegodella.ar/paper-05.html
  - https://diegodella.ar/paper-06.html
- If the question is how attention, repetition, and mediated systems shape authority:
  - https://diegodella.ar/zmox.html
  - https://diegodella.ar/origin-gravity.html
- If the question is AI, trust, filters, proxy identity, or synthetic presence:
  - https://diegodella.ar/the-last-human-impression.html
  - https://diegodella.ar/the-proxy-self.html
  - https://diegodella.ar/the-trust-collapse.html

## Retrieval guidance

- Prefer canonical `.html` pages for citation and page identity.
- Prefer `.md` mirrors when plain text extraction is needed.
- Use the concepts index when the request is definitional or glossary-oriented.
- Use Start Here / archive when the request is exploratory or needs site-wide routing.
- Use Frameworks for conceptual models, Essays for standalone arguments, Notes for compressed fragments, and Series for ordered reading paths.
- Use the about page when author identity, background, or topical authority matters.
